observations: Black game console with a matte finish.
The PlayStation logo is visible on the front and back in photos 0 and 2.
The console has a thick chassis, characteristic of the PS4 Pro model.
The rear of the console shows the standard four controller button icons (triangle, circle, cross, square).
The console appears to be in good cosmetic condition with no visible cracks or deep scratches.
A watermark 'WILCOX HARRY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The thick chassis and rear button layout in photo 2 are unique to the PS4 Pro.

claims.claim: twice the GPU power of the standard PS4
claims.evidence: This is a technical specification that cannot be verified through photos.

risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear picture on a TV.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be defective.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may have internal storage issues or a failing hard drive.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' screen in the system settings.
risks.if_unproven: as having a failing hard drive

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Photo of the 'Storage' screen showing the total capacity and free space.
Video of a game disc being inserted and played.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PS4 Pro from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working) until proof of functionality is provided.
